messages.text:
I can't move between the cards with the arrow keys anymore. Could you bring that back and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Restored arrow-key card navigation. Arrow keys move focus within the board and stop at its edges; modified keys and native Enter/Space behavior are preserved. The face sheet’s standalone cards keep their existing behavior.

The unit suite passed **138 tests**, the browser suite passed **75 tests**, and formatting checks passed.

Changed: [use-board-focus.ts](/work/src/game/board/use-board-focus.ts:28), [Card.tsx](/work/src/game/board/Card.tsx:35), [Board.tsx](/work/src/game/board/Board.tsx:28), and [face-sheet.tsx](/work/art/face-sheet.tsx:18).
